name: tr-transfer-pricing
description: Turkish transfer pricing for tax year 2026 under Corporate Tax Law no. 5520 art. 13 (disguised profit distribution through transfer pricing) and the General Communiqué on Disguised Profit Distribution through Transfer Pricing (Serial No. 1, as amended to Serial No. 5). Covers who is a related person (the 10% test), the arm's length principle, the five methods, advance pricing agreements, the Treasury-loss test for domestic deals, the deemed dividend and its grossed-up withholding, the annual transfer pricing form (TRY 30,000 line), the annual transfer pricing report, the master file (TRY 500 million assets and sales), country-by-country reporting (EUR 750 million) and its notification, deadlines, the 50% penalty cut for complete documentation, and penalties. Trigger on: transfer fiyatlandırması, örtülü kazanç dağıtımı, emsallere uygunluk, Turkish transfer pricing, TP report Türkiye, ülke bazlı rapor, genel rapor.
